sections.Profile:
"Heavy Metal Meltdown," released by Bally in January 1987, is a solid-state pinball machine known for its high-energy theme and music-based design. It features two flippers, one ramp, and a multiball option with a capacity for up to five balls. Designed by Dan Langlois with artwork by Tony Ramunni, the machine has an alphanumeric display and was produced in a limited run of 1,600 units.
